Those bots are at it again! This portable radio broadcasts their favorite tracks - strange, noisy, and weirdly catchy. Take it anywhere and blast the tunes!

99ae2a73-b28d-4b7c-a558-104ed1b59b1d.description:
Spreads the music through every corner of your home or vehicle - from the garage to the attic. Connect it to a radio and the sound will follow you anywhere!

By Xrisofor.

a287092e-06c4-4dcf-8166-2224c251f47c.description:
Switches tracks on a linked radio, even if it's buried deep inside your build. Bind the remote to a specific radio - and the music stays within reach.
